description: Method parameters of the label-trained 20-gene classifier, read by classifier.R and classifier_explainer.R. Gene eligibility is set in vendor/base/config/numerical_contract.json, training labels and excluded genes in R/population_policy.R.

gene_ranking.method: Descending limma moderated t of EC versus other terminal EEC, fitted on donor/sample-by-class mean log-expression, paired within donor/sample, each donor/sample weighted 1 / (donors/samples in its study); ties by gene symbol. Panels of 10, 20 and 30 genes are the top of this one ranked list.
gene_ranking.redundancy_note: A gene would be dropped only when its absolute Spearman correlation with a higher-ranked kept gene is above the ceiling; at 1 every ranked gene is kept.

composite_score.standardization: Gene mean and SD fitted on the training cells only, each training study weighted equally.
composite_score.gene_weight: Median across training studies of the EC minus other terminal EEC difference of donor/sample means, negative values set to 0, normalized to sum to 1.
composite_score.score: Weighted mean of the panel genes' standardized expression.
composite_score.detection_requirement: min(panel_size, max(2, ceiling(0.25 * panel_size))) panel genes detected, e.g. 5 of 20.

gmm.model: Two-component equal-variance Gaussian mixture fitted to the scores of training cells that meet the detection requirement, each training study weighted equally. The threshold is where the two weighted components cross; a fit that fails a floor below has no threshold.

local_enrichment_check.description: Second stage of the call, as in the four-marker EC classifier: inside the scored study, a candidate is kept when its nearest neighbors hold more candidates than the study-wide candidate share predicts (hypergeometric upper tail, Benjamini-Hochberg within the study's candidates). The graph is built from the study's own cells, without reading any label.
